name: Personal presentation defaults — V4 muted red and grey
applies_to: Built-in layouts unless the user explicitly selects a different style; preserve supplied corporate templates.
surface_policy: White canvas; charcoal table headers with white text; pale red/grey rows and panels; muted red emphasis. Use white text on solid accent fills.
density: Compact figures with explanatory text and comparison tables where useful
typography_policy: Match the V4 visual hierarchy: 29 pt titles, 18 pt explanatory body, 17 pt subtitles, 13 pt section headings, 14 pt tables/diagrams, and 10 pt captions. Compact figure labels may use 10–17 pt where needed; reflow or split content rather than shrink all slide text.
